notice: ITrackZen supports many GPS tracker models and protocols. Contact us if your device is not listed.
disclaimer: Brand and model names are trademarks of their respective owners and are used only to describe compatibility. The lists are representative, not exhaustive. Final compatibility depends on firmware version, configuration and network, and is confirmed by our team.

categories.title: OBD Trackers
categories.text: Plug-and-play OBD-II trackers installed in seconds with no wiring. Ideal for cars, vans and rental fleets.

categories.title: 4G GPS Trackers
categories.text: LTE trackers for faster, more reliable data as 2G networks are retired in many markets.

categories.title: Motorcycle Trackers
categories.text: Compact, waterproof and tamper-resistant devices for boda-boda, delivery bikes and scooters.

categories.title: Asset Trackers
categories.text: Battery-powered trackers for trailers, containers, generators and equipment.

categories.title: Fuel Sensor Compatible
categories.text: Devices with analog, RS232 or RS485 inputs that read fuel level sensors for monitoring and theft detection.

categories.title: Dashcam GPS Devices
categories.text: AI dashcams and MDVR systems that combine video with GPS location and driver-safety events.

brands.name: Teltonika
brands.desc: Industry-leading professional trackers: FMB (2G), FMC (4G LTE Cat 1), FMM (LTE Cat M1 / NB-IoT), FMU (3G) series, asset trackers and DualCam video.

brands.name: Concox
brands.desc: Popular, cost-effective vehicle, motorcycle, asset and personal trackers from Concox (also sold under many brand names).

brands.name: GT06 / GT02 Protocol Family
brands.desc: Thousands of low-cost trackers use the GT06 and GT02 protocols. If your device is described as GT06, GT06N, GT02 or 'GT06 compatible', it is very likely supported.

brands.name: Queclink
brands.desc: Reliable vehicle, asset and personal trackers with strong power-saving and fleet features.

brands.name: Coban
brands.desc: Widely used entry-level vehicle and motorcycle trackers in the GPS102 / GPS103 / GPS303 family.

brands.name: Meitrack
brands.desc: Fleet, personal and video trackers known for rugged build and fuel / sensor connectivity.

brands.name: Ruptela
brands.desc: European fleet telematics with CAN-bus, tachograph and fuel sensor integrations.

brands.name: Jimi IoT
brands.desc: Vehicle trackers, asset trackers and AI dashcams from Jimi IoT, including the JC series video telematics devices.

brands.name: Suntech
brands.desc: Robust trackers widely used in fleet and anti-theft applications.

brands.name: TopflyTech
brands.desc: Affordable vehicle, OBD and 4G trackers with fuel and sensor options.

brands.name: Xexun
brands.desc: Classic TK-series vehicle and personal trackers.

brands.name: Sinotrack
brands.desc: Compact, budget-friendly trackers popular for motorcycles, cars and small fleets.

brands.name: TKSTAR
brands.desc: Magnetic asset, vehicle and personal trackers, including 4G models.

brands.name: Gosafe
brands.desc: Vehicle and fleet trackers with sensor and camera support.

brands.name: Galileosky
brands.desc: Advanced telematics terminals for heavy fleet monitoring.

brands.name: Totem
brands.desc: Compact trackers for vehicles and assets.

brands.name: iStartek
brands.desc: Fleet trackers for vehicles and trailers.

brands.name: Dashcams & MDVR (JT/T 808)
brands.desc: AI dashcams and mobile DVRs that report GPS and events over standard protocols. Camera brand support varies by model and is confirmed on request.

brands.name: Smartphones & Generic Protocols
brands.desc: Use compatible smartphone tracking apps or any device that speaks a standard tracking protocol.

sensors: Fuel level sensors (capacitive, ultrasonic and Bluetooth, on compatible devices)
RFID and iButton driver ID readers
Relays for immobilisation and engine cut-off
Bluetooth sensors such as Teltonika EYE-type beacons (on compatible devices)
